item.tib: pha rgyud rig pa khu byug gsang mchog mthar thug rgyal po'i rgyud las ma rgyud ba ga klong chen kun sgrol mkha' 'gro 'bum bskul gyi las tshogs
item.coloph: de ltar ma rgyud snying po'i bon 'di dag phyi rabs sgrub brtson skal ldan skyes bu yis/ gtsang dag dam ldan tshul bzhin spyod pa na/ 'dir yang tshe ring nad med bsod nams 'phel/ ma sring mkha' 'gro'i zhal ston dngos grub gnang*/ mchog thun yo byad phun tshogs ngo mtshar ldan/ bar chod tshogs zhi dge spyod don cher 'grub/ nyams rtogs ting 'dzin khyad 'phags rgyud la 'char/ phyi mar sgrib sbyangs tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs nas/ u rgyan mkha' spyod bde ba'i gnas su 'khod/ rgyun zhugs 'bras bus 'gro ba'i don mdzad nas/ shes rab phar phyin dbyings su sangs rgyas nas/ de phyir 'di yi yon tan brjod las 'das/ phyi rabs las 'phro can la snyan du brgyud/ de skad gsungs nas yab kyis yum la gdams/ yum gyis gnas dus rten 'brel 'dzoms pa la/ nges med rnal 'byor bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis ma sring mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin bgyis/ ma rig 'khrul skyon tshod yod ra chod spangs/ da lta phyi rabs gang zag don ched du/ gnas la khyad 'phags spu ze zab mo yi/ ri mtsho mtshan ldan maN Dal bkod 'dra ru/ ston zla tha chung dus su yi ger btabs/ nyes 'gal ci mchis mkha' 'gro nyid la bshags//
